subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris has been successfully confirmed. Your itinerary details are as follows: Flight 123, Departure: 10th August, 2022 at 9:00 AM, Arrival: 10th August, 2022 at 1:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
